metadata_source: Zhang et al. (2020), LS-SSDD-v1.0, Table 2 and Figure 3: https://doi.org/10.3390/rs12182997; UTC dates from original Tools/user_manual.pdf product IDs (the paper dates differ for scenes 08 and 13).
selection_rule: Predeclared before training. Remove original training scenes 06 and 09 near test Gulf of Cadiz/Gibraltar, and 07 near validation English Channel. Keep dates, named geographic groups and scene IDs disjoint. This is a custom strict split, not the official random/scene benchmark score.
nearshore_definition: Official test_inshore.txt: image contains land, not a measured distance-to-shore threshold.
metric_limits: Physical calibration not assumed from radar resolution. Metre/area metrics await verified pixel spacing.

quarantine.reason: Conservative cross-split dHash<=3 quarantine; similarity is not confirmed duplication
